summary: This set strengthens the media test coverage around video and image conversion, encoder input validation, and YUV/chroma sizing. New gtests exercise picture-region handling, undersized source surfaces, odd/odd-dimension YUV buffers, WebM cluster timing, and encoder lifecycle visibility so regressions in video encoding/decoding (including muted chunks and time-stretched audio) are caught earlier. That helps keep WebRTC, Media Source/encoding paths, and GMP-based encoders reliable across platforms.
